title: Edit panel composition
question: Which Edit details drawer composition should we build? All keep TipTap bubble-on-selection and every Sportshub field.

options.label: Sectioned timeline
options.thesis: Labeled Basic / Time / Location / Booking. Time uses a start–end timeline with pill date/time controls; Booking is a quiet grid.
options.viewport: Right drawer over Details: large title, seamless description with bubble menu, timeline Time, address Location, sport/capacity/price/form/link, yellow Update event.
options.risk: Four sections can feel longer on mobile sheets.

options.label: Dense flush
options.thesis: Hero title, minimal section framing, compact time inset, Booking as flush divided rows so more fields fit the first viewport.
options.viewport: Same drawer grammar; denser stack; TipTap still bubble-only; yellow Update event footer.
options.risk: Can feel tighter than the Luma reference’s calm.

options.label: Airy document
options.thesis: Generous section spacing, tall prose description, timeline rail—reads like editing a document more than filling a form.
options.viewport: Spacious Basic → Time → Location → Booking; bubble TipTap; yellow Update event.
options.risk: Booking fields may sit below the fold on laptop heights.
